title: Compare Two Rental Options
instructions: Write your own first draft using your own details. Do not copy the speaking example.
prompt: Write 120–160 words to a friend comparing two fictional rental homes. Describe the rent and at least two room features, compare one bill or repair question, and explain which place you prefer. Use at least six different lesson words and include a comparative, an as ... as sentence, and too or enough.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: Write four parts: the two places; room comparison; rent, bill and questions for the landlord; your choice and reason. Treat the contract as a fictional offer and do not assume universal rental rules.
